result.summary: Found 1 clear visual defect: the metadata line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' is garbled/overlapping. A couple of minor edge-truncation behaviors appear intentional for carousel/scroll but are worth verifying.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', the info line is rendered as overlapping/garbled text (reads like '25–3€0rd€livery · Ramen'), where the ETA ('25–30 min'), delivery fee ('€0 delivery'), and tag ('Ramen') appear to collide in the same space instead of being separated.
issues.suggestion: Lay out the ETA, delivery fee, and cuisine tag as separate spans with proper horizontal spacing/dividers (e.g., '25–30 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') and ensure the row does not overlap; add a UI test for concatenated metadata strings.

issues.description: The right-edge carousel card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is clipped mid-name at the viewport boundary.
issues.suggestion: If intentional as a scroll peek, keep consistent peek width; otherwise add padding/margin so restaurant names are not abruptly cut off.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is partially cut off at the bottom of the visible area, showing only the top of the pizza image and '-20%' badge.
issues.suggestion: Acceptable for scrollable content, but consider increasing vertical spacing or snapping card boundaries so partial content looks deliberate rather than clipped.
